user_id.description: The user this streak belongs to.

club_id.description: The club this streak is for. Each club has its own independent streak per member.

current_streak.description: Current consecutive net check-in streak for this club. Resets when a qualifying net is missed.

longest_streak.description: Highest streak ever achieved for this club. Permanently recorded even after the current streak resets.

total_checkins.description: Total qualifying check-ins for this club.

total_nets_attended.description: Total net sessions attended for this club.

last_session_id.description: The NetControlSession ID of the last check-in. Prevents duplicate check-ins from inflating the streak.
